text: The MRI shows disseminated white matter lesions, which could indicate multiple sclerosis or a vascular issue, but the rapid cognitive decline and paranoia are atypical. speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Known history of HIV, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Noncompliance with medications for over 2 years. Social history: Information not provided

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your HIV history and noncompliance, I am concerned about an opportunistic infection like PML. REQUEST TEST: HIV_Viral_Load REQUEST TEST: CD4_Count

speaker: Doctor
text: The extremely low CD4 count and high viral load in the context of disseminated white matter lesions and subacute neurological decline strongly point to Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)
